 Travis County early voting for Dec. 12 runoff starts Nov. 30 
 Election Central Austin Travis County early voting for Dec. 12 runoff starts Nov. 30
 Explore Central Austin on the Impact Map stories, offers and more Jessica Mclaren 1 min read Published November 20, 2026 at 3:40 p.m. CT Polls are open 7 a.m.-7 p.m. during early voting and on Election Day, and voters can vote at any polling site in the county. ( Jessica McLaren/Community Impact ) Travis County voters can cast ballots early from Nov. 30 to Dec. 8 in the Dec. 12 runoff , which includes three Austin City Council seats .
 What’s on the ballot  
 District 1: Amber Goodwin and Misael Ramos are competing for the open seat, which covers East and Northeast Austin.
 District 3: Incumbent José Velásquez faces challenger Neha Shah for the seat, which spans East, South and Southeast Austin.
 District 5: Incumbent Ryan Alter faces David Weinberg to represent this West and Southwest Austin district.
 Dates to know 
 Early voting: Nov. 30-Dec. 8. Polls are open 7 a.m.-7 p.m., and noon-6 p.m. on Sunday, according to the Travis County Clerk .
 Last day to apply for a mail ballot: Dec. 1
 Election Day: Dec. 12, 7 a.m.-7 p.m.
 Voter registration: The deadline for this election passed Nov. 12.
 Where to vote 
 Travis County voters may vote at any polling site in the county. Commissioners took up the early voting and Election Day locations at their Nov. 17 meeting, and the clerk posted lists of early voting and Election Day sites .
 Before you go 
 Check the county’s voter ID requirements and mail ballot lookup .
